name: Medina of Tétouan (formerly known as Titawin)
description: Tucked into the hills of northern Morocco, a short drive from the Strait of Gibraltar, Tétouan's whitewashed old town was rebuilt around 1500 by refugees from Granada, and its houses and craftsmanship still show Andalusian style. Though among Morocco's smaller medinas, it is the most complete, and its lanes are still lived in. Locals call it "Granada's Daughter.
